skill.name: ai-image-generation
skill.description: Generate, edit, upscale, and stitch AI images through the inference.sh CLI using FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve, Pruna, and related models.
skill.summary: Run inference.sh image models for text-to-image, editing, upscaling, stitching, and model discovery.
skill.author: inferen-sh

security_audit.summary: Most static Ruby/backtick detections are Markdown fences or inline code examples, not executable Ruby or shell substitution. The meaningful risks are the intended use of the inference.sh CLI with remote model providers, an embedded external image asset, and optional related-skill installer commands. No evidence of prompt injection, credential theft, or hidden exfiltration instructions was found.

remediation.issue: Remote model calls can expose prompts and image URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear privacy warning before generation examples and advise users not to send secrets, private images, or regulated data without approval.

remediation.issue: The skill permits a broad infsh command surface.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the allowed tool scope limited to required image commands if finer permissions are available, and avoid encouraging unrelated infsh operations.

remediation.issue: Related skill installation commands increase supply-chain exposure.
remediation.suggestion: Present related skill installs as manual, review-first actions and include source verification guidance before running npx skills add commands.

remediation.issue: The README embeds a remote image asset.
remediation.suggestion: Use a marketplace-hosted or proxied image asset when possible to reduce direct third-party asset fetches.

semantic_findings.title: External CLI Execution and Remote Model Calls
semantic_findings.description: The skill grants Bash(infsh *) and instructs the agent to run inference.sh image apps with prompts and image URLs. This can send user prompts and referenced images to inference.sh and downstream model providers.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The allowed-tools line explicitly permits infsh commands, and multiple examples invoke remote image apps. The data egress risk follows directly from the documented workflow.

semantic_findings.title: Related Skill Installer Commands

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The installer commands are explicit in the documentation, but they are presented as user-facing related-skill guidance rather than automatically executed steps.

content.value_statement: Creating visuals across many AI image models can require separate tools and prompts. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code concise inference.sh guidance for generation, editing, upscaling, and discovery.
actual_capabilities: Provides inference.sh workflows for text-to-image generation.
Shows model choices for FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve, Pruna, and ImagineArt.
Guides image editing and upscaling through supported image apps.
Demonstrates stitching multiple image URLs into one output image.
Includes model discovery guidance for browsing image apps.
Links related inference.sh skills for adjacent image and video workflows.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI to be installed and authenticated.
Uses remote services, so prompts and image URLs may leave the local environment.
Does not provide local image rendering or asset storage.
Model availability and pricing depend on inference.sh.

use_cases.title: Design Concept Exploration
use_cases.description: Create quick visual directions, mood studies, and composition ideas using several image model families.

use_cases.title: Marketing Visual Drafts
use_cases.description: Draft product photos, campaign concepts, social graphics, and promotional illustrations before final design work.

use_cases.title: Developer Image Automation
use_cases.description: Use repeatable CLI-based workflows for generated images, edits, upscales, and stitched assets.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a polished square image of [subject] with clear lighting, a simple background, and a realistic style.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend an inference.sh image model for [goal]. Explain the tradeoffs for quality, speed, aspect ratio, and text rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Edit or Upscale an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the best image app to improve [image URL]. Preserve the main subject while changing [requested change] and increasing output quality.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Step Visual Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a workflow for [campaign or product]. Generate initial concepts, refine one image, upscale it, and prepare final usage notes.

output_examples.input: Create a studio product photo of a matte black travel mug.
output_examples.output: A focused image-generation plan with a product photography prompt, suggested model, aspect ratio guidance, and review notes.

output_examples.input: Improve this image URL and make it suitable for a hero banner.
output_examples.output: A recommended editing or upscaling workflow that preserves the subject, improves clarity, and prepares a wide banner output.

output_examples.input: Find an economical model for quick social media concepts.
output_examples.output: A short model recommendation with speed, cost, and quality considerations for rapid concept generation.

best_practices: State the subject, style, lighting, aspect ratio, and intended use before generation.
Review prompts and image URLs for sensitive information before sending them to remote services.
Use fast models for drafts, then use higher quality models or upscaling for final assets.
anti_patterns: Do not send private images, secrets, or regulated data to remote model services without approval.
Do not run installer commands for related skills without reviewing the source and trust level.
Do not expect identical output across models, runs, or future platform changes.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create AI images, edits, upscales, stitched images, product visuals, illustrations, and concept art through inference.sh.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require an external service?
faq.answer: Yes. It depends on the inference.sh CLI and remote model apps.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes image editing, image upscaling, and image stitching examples using image URLs.

faq.question: Is it safe for private images?
faq.answer: Use caution. Prompts and image URLs may be sent to external services and model providers.

faq.question: Does it replace design review?
faq.answer: No. Generated visuals still need human review for accuracy, branding, rights, and quality.
